properties.name: Plaza Premium Lounge  (Near Gate 60, Departures)
properties.description:
THE LOUNGE

Step into a peaceful sanctuary near Gate 60 in Terminal 1 of Hong Kong International Airport, relax in comfortable seating while enjoying the natural light and a breathtaking tarmac view beneath you—a perfect backdrop for your travel experience, your true destination before departure. 

Indulge in our culinary delights blending local and global influences, including our "Proudly Local" Hong Kong-style fish ball noodles paired with our signature XO sauce and a refreshing selection of beverages—from selected house wine and beer to premium coffee, tea, and soft drinks. Whether you wish to enjoy freshly made meals or freshen up in our showers, we are here to ensure your airport experience is both enjoyable and memorable.

Introducing Lounge To-Go, our innovative option for travelers on the move. Grab a delicious meal that serves as a perfect inflight replacement, allowing you to savor the flavors of our lounge even while you travel.
properties.address: Level 7, Departures Level, Terminal 1, Hong Kong International Airport (near Gate 60)

properties.name: Plaza Premium First  (Near Gate 1, East Hall)
properties.description:
The Lounge

An Elevated Lounge Experience for Elite Travellers

Nestled conveniently near Gate 1 at Hong Kong International Airport, Plaza Premium First (Gate 1, East Hall) brings about an elevated airport lounge concept offering an array of all-inclusive personalised services and exquisite dining experiences amid a relaxing lounge ambiance adorned with crafted interior.  Indulge in sumptuous international and local gourmet dishes, complemented by an assortment of delectable desserts. Guests can also enjoy our signature craft cocktails inspired by local flavors, as well as a curated selection of fine spirits and wines.

For an unparalleled travel experience, discover Infinity Room, a unique “Lounge within a Lounge” offering an immersive environment that guarantees exclusive privacy, exquisite dining and exceptional service for selected elite travelers. The culinary journey in the Infinity Room features a delightful a-la-carte menu that artfully blends locally-inspired specialties with international delicacies, along with a refined selection of wines, spirits, Chinese and Western teas, juices, and other refreshing beverages.

Please visit PlazapremiumFirst for more details.

properties.description:

Indulge in our sumptuous buffet featuring freshly made meals, light refreshments, and a diverse range of beverages—from selected house wine and beer to premium coffee, tea, and soft drinks. Elevated culinary options are available exclusively for Smart Traveller members through ST Point redemptions. What's more, enjoy access to our cozy relaxation zone, where we are dedicated to taking care of your needs and helping you create unforgettable airport moments.

Join now and get 150 welcome bonus points and explore exclusive privileges: ST sign up 

Introducing Lounge To-Go, our innovative option for travelers on the move. Grab a delicious halal meal that serves as a perfect inflight replacement, allowing you to savor the flavors of our lounge experience even while you travel.

For lounge access outside of our operating hours, we invite our guests to visit the Plaza Premium Lounge located near Gate 60 in the Departures area

termsPolicies.description:
Private Relaxation Area: Cancellation/ amendments may be made up to 24 hours before the indicated check-in time. A fee of USD10 per person or 25% of the total booking amount, whichever is higher, is payable.

All other services: Cancellation/ amendments may be made up to 6 hours before the indicated arrival time. A fee of USD10 per person is payable.

Late cancellation and/ or failure to arrive at the facility will be considered as No Show and the booking will not be refunded. Please refer to our full Terms & Conditions.

The baggage wrapping service is only available from 5:00 - 00:00 daily at departure hall in Hong Kong International Airport. Please ensure you approach to the designated baggage wrap counter to wrap your bags for checking them in during this operation hours even your flight may depart after mid night time.

No baggage wrapping service e.g. cabin baggage is provided at restricted area when you are accessing our lounges in Airside after passing through the security and passport control.

This service covers wrapping for regular sized baggage with total dimension not exceeding 199cm (Length + Width + Height) for one piece.
